# Get Auth Details.vi

![Get Auth Details.vi function icon](../../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/WS-APP-SEC-03.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../../../index.md) · [All functions](../../../../index.md)

Reads Application Web Server username, groups, permissions and login-session key.
